rule: This file records where shared English learning/runtime work should continue. It is not exam/source truth, not private learner state, and not a substitute for LEARNING_CONTRACT.md or module contracts. A fresh Chat should read this cursor plus the referenced Current owners before proposing new English work.
completed_shared_work: English Current consolidation completed: concise manifest, provenance separation, canonical exam/source assets, and Current-only Astro gating.
Global English LEARNING_CONTRACT.md frozen around Clean Attempt -> first meaningful failure -> smallest sufficient repair -> reconstruction -> transfer.
Module-specific cognition is frozen; one diagnostic taxonomy must not be forced across Reading A, Cloze, Part B, Translation, and Writing.
Reading A module contract completed: understand -> locate decisive evidence -> adjudicate options -> execute.
Reading A clean-attempt surface exists in Astro with passage/question split, A-D controls, Uncertain, timer/progress, keyboard navigation, and optional lightweight marking.
Reading A post-submit behavior already compresses stable-correct items and prioritizes wrong/uncertain items.
Reading A private interaction evidence includes answers, uncertainty, timing/history, answer trajectory when captured, optional quick cause, and compact copy-to-Chat handoff.
Canonical English exam source is materialized and verified: 27 papers, 235 sets, 1364 questions/prompts; Reading corpus has 110 passages and 540 questions.
External-reading inventory and object schema exist; TPO56-65 and IELTS17-19 remain candidate private unseen material and are not bulk-materialized for completeness.

next_action.instruction: Run one real Reading A passage through the current Astro flow before adding more English UI or diagnostic taxonomy. Observe the learner from clean attempt through submission, compressed stable-correct handling, wrong/uncertain repair, and Chat handoff. Patch only friction demonstrated by real use.
next_action.source_choice: Use a canonical exam Reading A passage when memory residue is acceptable. If prior exposure makes it non-diagnostic, materialize exactly one selected TPO/IELTS external-reading object under the existing schema and use it as the validation passage; do not bulk-build the external corpus.
observe: ATTEMPT_FRICTION: controls, layout, marking, timer, or navigation distract from reading/answering.
OVER_REVIEW: stable correct items create unnecessary explanation or second-pass work.
UNDER_DIAGNOSIS: wrong/uncertain handoff lacks the minimum evidence Chat needs to identify the first meaningful failure.
REPAIR_BLOAT: a local failure opens more passage/explanation than necessary.
MEMORY_RESIDUE: reused true-exam material looks strong only because the learner remembers it.
TRANSFER: after repair, later unseen material is the stronger mastery signal.
next_action.success_condition: The learner can complete a passage with exam-like focus, stable correct items disappear quickly, only meaningful failures expand, and Chat can diagnose deeper failures from a compact handoff without the learner manually retelling the attempt.

do_not_reopen_without_new_evidence: Do not create more English governance/contract files merely for completeness.
Do not force one failure taxonomy or one review-card shape across all English modules.
Do not show formal answers, evidence, explanations, teacher methods, or prior-attempt analysis before a clean attempt.
Do not require annotation, quick-cause labels, or note-taking for every question.
Do not make stable-correct questions enter full review by default.
Do not turn teacher-method material into the default learning path; it remains a repair reservoir.
Do not duplicate lexical knowledge inside Reading/Cloze/Translation when LexicalOS is the canonical owner.
Do not bulk-materialize TPO/IELTS merely to complete a corpus; preserve unseen diagnostic capital and materialize incrementally when selected for real study.
Do not treat accuracy on memorized true-exam passages as equivalent to unseen mastery.
Do not add UI controls/panels unless they improve score reliability, reduce high-value friction, preserve diagnostic evidence, or enable more precise repair/transfer.
after_validation: Patch Reading A based on observed friction, preferring deletion/simplification and progressive disclosure over new panels.
Materialize external reading incrementally only when real unseen study requires it.
Create/upgrade another module contract or Astro interaction only when that module becomes the active learner task; do not prebuild empty module systems.
Preserve the global 80–85+ / objective 60/60 target and smallest-sufficient-repair philosophy.

continuation_policy.update_when: Update at meaningful English shared-work stage transitions or when the next active module/action changes materially.
continuation_policy.fresh_chat_rule: Read main@HEAD CURRENT.md, this continuation file, LEARNING_CONTRACT.md, and only the Current module/source owners needed by next_action. Continue from next_action rather than reconstructing the roadmap from prior chats.
